latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of vitepress-config skill.

- Provides quick start and configuration reference for VitePress.
- Covers theme customization, routing, markdown extensions, and data loading.
- Includes frontmatter examples and core configuration options.
- Lists CLI commands and reference documentation files.
- Useful links to official docs and GitHub included.
